foreignQualification.feeBasis: Flat $90.00 filing fee for the Application for Certificate of Authority, listed for foreign corporations and LLCs on the Business Filings fee page.
foreignQualification.formName: Application for Certificate of Authority for a Foreign Business Entity
foreignQualification.filedWith: Kentucky Secretary of State, Division of Business Filings, P.O. Box 718, Frankfort, KY 40602
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File the annual report by June 30 of each year after the year the entity was formed, accompanied by the $15.00 filing fee, and maintain a registered agent in Kentucky.

evidence.quote: Foreign Corporation or Limited Liability Company (Profit, Non-Profit or Professional Service) Application for Certificate of Authority: $90.00
APPLICATION FOR CERTIFICATE OF AUTHORITY FOR A FOREIGN BUSINESS ENTITY
Division of Business Filings P.O. Box 718 Frankfort, KY 40602
Your annual report must be signed, dated and accompanied by a $15 filing fee.
annual report by June 30 of each year after the year they are formed.

notes: The form covers LLCs among other foreign business entity types (the type is indicated by checkbox), and its instructions state the registered office must be in Kentucky with a street address. Root states.json carries Kentucky's annual report fee at $15 due January 1 - June 30.
